[[File:Sopa de melón.jpg|thumb|A cold melon soup with [[Garnish (food)|garnishes]]]]

'''Melon soup''' is a soup prepared with [[melon]] as a primary ingredient.<ref name="Sackett Pestka Gisslen 2010 p. 302"/> Melons such as [[bitter melon]], [[cantaloupe]], [[crenshaw melon]], [[Honeydew (melon)|honeydew]] (casaba melon) and [[winter melon]] may be used,<ref name="Sackett Pestka Gisslen 2010 p. 302"/><ref name="Larsen 2009 p. 227"/><ref name="Woods 2000 p. 158"/> among others. Some melon soups are prepared with whole pieces of melon, and others use [[purée]]d melon.<ref name="Larsen 2009 p. 227"/> Some are served hot, while others are served chilled.<ref name="Piotrowski"/> Some cold varieties are prepared without any cooking involved.<ref name="Nowlan 2008 p. 50"/> Several styles and varieties of melon soups exist, including bitter melon soup, cantaloupe soup and winter melon soup,<ref name="Chen Yan 2009 p. 137"/><ref name="Fabricant 2015"/><ref name="Chen Yan 2009 p. 237"/> among others. The origin of some melon soup recipes may cross international boundaries.{{clarify|date=September 2017}}
